description: This file defines interfaces, functions, and classes for calculating image statistics such as mean, variance, covariance, and SSIM, specifically for image channels with an implementation optimized for performance.

classes.name: FastStats
classes.description: A class implementing the Stats interface with optimized methods for calculating partial sums, means, variances, and covariance for image channels.

methods.name: ssim
methods.description: Calculates the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) between two regions of images based on provided statistics.

methods.name: meanC1
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the first image channel over a specified region.

methods.name: meanC2
methods.description: Calculates the mean of the second image channel over a specified region.

methods.name: varianceC1
methods.description: Calculates the population variance of the first image channel over a specified region.

methods.name: varianceC2
methods.description: Calculates the population variance of the second image channel over a specified region.

methods.name: covariance
methods.description: Calculates the covariance between the two image channels over a specified region.
